verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is a locally run, open-source infrastructure-as-code CLI with no hosted service, account system or API of its own (probes found no OpenAPI surface), so it has no credentials of its own to issue or scope. That makes this story a category error for the product type. Using providers to create cloud IAM credentials would be a capability of those clouds, not OpenTofu's own credential issuance, so it earns no credit.
